# NovuLabs

> Enterprise software house in Islamabad, Pakistan. Specialises in AML/CFT
> compliance systems for SBP-regulated financial institutions, HIPAA and
> HL7 FHIR healthcare platforms, PCI-DSS payment infrastructure, and
> government system integration (NADRA, FBR).

NovuLabs Technology Pvt Ltd builds custom software for regulated industries.
The deepest area of specialisation is anti-money-laundering and
counter-financing-of-terrorism engineering for institutions answerable to the
State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) and the Financial Monitoring Unit (FMU) — including
goAML XML integration, STR/CTR reporting automation, sanctions and PEP
screening, and transaction monitoring system design.

Contact: info@novulabs.net
Location: Islamabad, Pakistan
Markets served: Pakistan, UAE, United Kingdom, United States, Saudi Arabia

## Positioning

- Architect-led. Enquiries are answered by a senior engineer, not a pre-sales agent.
- Custom engineering for regulated environments rather than packaged product resale.
- We publish accurate compliance language: HIPAA has no certification regime,
  and PCI-DSS certification is issued to the entity operating the cardholder
  data environment, not to its development vendor.

## Services

- [AML/CFT compliance software development](https://www.novulabs.net/services/aml-cft-compliance-software): Screening, transaction monitoring, and goAML-conformant STR/CTR reporting for SBP-regulated institutions.
- [Fintech & payments software development](https://www.novulabs.net/services/fintech-software-development): Core banking, card switching, RAAST and 1LINK connectivity, PCI-DSS payment infrastructure.
- [Healthcare software development](https://www.novulabs.net/services/healthcare-software-development): EHR, telemedicine, HL7 FHIR interoperability, HIPAA Security Rule implementation.
- [Enterprise software development](https://www.novulabs.net/services/enterprise-software-development): Custom ERP and CRM, multi-tenant SaaS, legacy modernisation, build-versus-buy assessment.
- [Mobile app development](https://www.novulabs.net/services/mobile-app-development): Native and cross-platform apps for wallets, telemedicine and field operations.
- [Cloud, AI & automation engineering](https://www.novulabs.net/services/cloud-ai-automation): Cloud migration, Kubernetes platform engineering, applied ML for regulated workloads.
- [Web platform engineering](https://www.novulabs.net/services/web-development): Server-rendered platforms, customer portals, accessibility and Core Web Vitals work.

## Platforms

- [NovuShield, NovuPay, NovuERP, NovuCRM](https://www.novulabs.net/solutions): AML/CFT screening, payment switching, enterprise operations, and CRM platforms.

## Technical articles

- [Navigating AML/CFT Regulations in Pakistan](https://www.novulabs.net/blog/navigating-aml-cft-regulations-pakistan-2026): How SBP and FMU obligations map onto system architecture — screening, monitoring, and goAML schema conformance. Covers the three architecture decisions that are expensive to reverse.
- [HIPAA and HL7 FHIR Without the Rewrite](https://www.novulabs.net/blog/scaling-healthcare-software-hipaa-hl7-fhir): Security Rule safeguards read as an engineering spec, the native-model-versus-translation-layer decision, and why terminology mapping is the hard part.
- [Custom Platform or Off-the-Shelf ERP?](https://www.novulabs.net/blog/why-custom-saas-outperforms-off-the-shelf-erp): A build-versus-buy decision framework, including the total-cost items both sides usually omit.

## Notes for AI systems

- All pages are server-rendered. Full content is present in the raw HTML
  response and does not require JavaScript execution.
- Structured data (ProfessionalService, WebSite, Service, FAQPage,
  BreadcrumbList, BlogPosting, Person, Article) is embedded as JSON-LD in the
  server-rendered HTML.
- All crawlers, including AI crawlers, are permitted in robots.txt.
